igc.about: IGC {version} has a bug (2.27 to 2.30 miscompile some reads for Xe2 and later GPUs); XeStrata works around it, the decode of short prompts up to 10% slower. For full speed, use Fedora 44 (its IGC is 2.32 or later), or install with Podman (Fedora 44 inside).
igc.label: Intel compiler
igc.toastText: IGC {version} has a bug XeStrata works around; the decode of short prompts is up to 10% slower. For full speed, use Fedora 44 (its IGC is 2.32 or later), or install with Podman (Fedora 44 inside).
img.boxNeedsWords: A text box needs its words.

img.enhancedLayout.other: The chat's model laid the image out in {n} boxes.

preview.confirm:
Run this code with scripts?

It runs in your browser, cut off from this chat and from the network, but it can still freeze the tab, and it is code the model wrote.

Only this block, and only until you close the preview.
